summary: Lead three engineering teams (25+ engineers across Pharmacovigilance, Corevitas RWE, and Vestrum MDM) as hands-on architect and product owner, owning a multi-million-dollar budget and technical roadmap. Architected serverless AWS Step Functions + Lambda platforms that orchestrate pharmacovigilance workflows end-to-end at 100K+ cases/year and 99.9% reliability, and built an agentic RAG platform (vector retrieval, LLM adverse-event extraction, human-in-the-loop guardrails) that cut manual case-processing time 40% and lifted extraction accuracy above 95%.

Architected and delivered adaptive end-to-end cloud solutions for complex systems integrations across Clario's global platforms, harmonizing clinical and operational data into a centralized platform on AWS (EC2, Glue, RDS, S3, Redshift, CloudFormation). Delivered Enterprise DW/MDM, OneSource clinical BI, ePRO/EXPERT, and business microservices; built Python/SQL ETL for eCOA, Cardiac, and Respiratory data and Tableau dashboards under SAFe Agile delivery.

Led clinical data management solutions and the design of world-class data pipelines. Performance-tuned mappings and sessions and wrote complex SQL to ingest iSpiro/AM3 and CGM responses under heavy volume. Designed a DDD microservice architecture with Python Flask REST APIs and set up full CI/CD pipelines using DevSecOps best practices.

Gathered requirements and designed, developed, and tested multiple clinical systems while leading technical guidance and code reviews. Developed stored procedures, functions, and packages in PL/SQL and built complex ePRO visit-scheduling screens with Oracle APEX and JavaScript.

Partnered with business users to design inbound/outbound interfaces and authored functional and technical specifications. Created and maintained stored procedures, functions, packages, and DB triggers, and developed custom Oracle Forms/Reports (11g/10g/6i) for complex calculations and automated scheduling in the ESPN Program Scheduling Application.

Defined system requirements and designed, prototyped, developed, tested, and implemented applications. Built events, validation master plans, and forms for Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), including Applied Biosystems' SQL*LIMS barcode system and lab-instrument interfaces, with extensive PL/SQL supporting core business logic.
